title: Azure Terraform Infrastructure Input
description: Top-level JSON input contract. Each Azure service's fields and validation rules are maintained in its own schema under schemas/services/.

subscription_id.title: Azure subscription ID
subscription_id.description: Replace the placeholder with your Azure subscription GUID.

org.title: Organization code
org.description: 2-12 lowercase letters/digits; optionally use single hyphens.

app.title: Application/platform code
app.description: 2-16 lowercase letters/digits; optionally use single hyphens.

resource_groups.title: Resource groups
resource_groups.description: Add one object per resource group. Add or remove objects to control the number created.

storage_accounts.title: Storage accounts
storage_accounts.description: Optional storage accounts. Each references a resource group instance; names are compacted to meet Azure restrictions.
